label: Client
notes: Central person entity in Acute. Source identifier is the client URI, for example /clients/123. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.

label: Organisation
notes: Company master entity for TTH organisation clients. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.

label: Employer
notes: Source bridge between Client and Organisation. Employer.clientId refers to the id part inside Client.client. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.

label: Invoice
notes: MF-issued outbound sales invoice. Payer is identified by payerClientId or payerOrgId. The endpoint supports incremental filtering with modifiedAfter.

label: InvoiceEvent
notes: Preferred analytical billed service line entity sourced from Invoice.events[]. The invoice endpoint must be called with showEvents=true.

label: Personnel
notes: MF staff and professionals, not patients and not employer employees. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.
